ratios.covenant_name: Consolidated Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio
ratios.quote: Our Consolidated Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio was 0.9 at September 30, 2026.

parsed.notes: The maximum 3.5x Consolidated Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio applies only as of quarter-ends when loans under the Revolving Credit Facilities are outstanding. There were no revolver borrowings at September 30, 2026, so the test was not technically triggered; the company reports compliance. The same ratio also sets pricing margins and commitment fees, and those were excluded. The European lines of credit have no covenant ratio disclosed.
